104-3490-5231-8333.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-5231-8333.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sickbay triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-789-3249-4549--52.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Gutter Grime triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

4871-5695-6019-8095.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Infested Thrinax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead abilities from steps 3 and 7, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

3147-5414-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Azorius Chancery.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Azorius Chancery from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Repeat.

2104-7370-7874.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling The Immortal Weapons.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning The Immortal Weapons from exile to the battlefield.
When The Immortal Weapons enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2034-4068-4289-6970-7850.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2034-4068-4289-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3455-6913.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3455-6913.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Chameleon and Vizier of Many Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3455-6913.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

849-1263-2292-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Anax trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2506-4772-7150-7752.description:
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1157-4955-7070--32.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting the Eldrazi.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the Eldrazi.
Grafted Wargear's ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the Eldrazi from exile by paying {0} due to Eye of Ugin.
Repeat.
1157-4955-7070--32.notes: The chosen Eldrazi must be colorless.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two card(s) exiled with it

1824-2530-6710-7350.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-6710-7350.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Demon's Horn triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6835-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Overseer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

104-360-2034-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-360-2034-3490.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

104-567-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-567-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

3817-3991-4050.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat from step 3.

339-413-677-6633.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

4593-4659-4716-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter enter, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
4593-4659-4716-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and/or Thopter

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1116-3240-5670-6578.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3240-5670-6578.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel and Sek'Kuar trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel and Nether Traitor trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.
1116-3240-5670-6578.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

331-1371-3432-6500.easyPrerequisites:
There is a land on the battlefield.
Each opponent has 80 or less life, or your life total is 81 or higher.
331-1371-3432-6500.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Tephraderm indestructible.
331-1371-3432-6500.description:
Give Tephraderm indestructible, if needed.
Cast Star of Extinction by paying {5}{R}{R}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Star of Extinction.
Resolve an opponent's Star of Extinction, destroying a land and dealing 40 damage to each creature and planeswalker due to Furnace of Rath.
Tephraderm's second ability triggers, dealing 80 damage to the opponent who controlled the Star of Extinction copy due to Furnace of Rath.
Repeat from step 4 for each remaining Star of Extinction.

31-1068-3255-3918.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}
When Leveler enters, it triggers, exiling your library.
Activate Trazyn the Infinite using Commander's Sphere's ability by sacrificing it.
Resolve the ability, using Out of the Tombs's ability to return Trazyn the Infinite from your graveyard to the battlefield instead of drawing a card.
Repeat from step 3.
31-1068-3255-3918.notes: You can pull off the core of this combo in the Necron Dynasties Warhammer 40K preconstructed Commander deck. First mill your library the hard way instead of using Leveler. If you did not draw any other combo pieces, you can even use Out of the Tombs to assemble the combo. First return Triarch Praetorian, which allows you to return Trazyn the Infinite and Psychomander (the win condition).

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1912-3719-5326-5400.notablePrerequisites: Synth Infiltrator has a power of at least 2.
1912-3719-5326-5400.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Synth Infiltrator and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Synth Infiltrator to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Synth Infiltrator by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4013-4112-5725.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Sharuum the Hegemon.
When Sharuum the Hegemon enters the battlefield, it and Monkey Cage trigger.
Resolve the Sharuum the Hegemon trigger, returning any artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Monkey Cage trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and create six 2/2 Ape creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Apes, adding six {C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Sharuum the Hegemon.
When Sharuum the Hegemon enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Monkey Cage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Blazing Sunsteel.

2723-3734.notablePrerequisites:
Blazing Sunsteel and Phyrexian Metamorph attached to an indestructible creature you control.
You have a way to deal damage to the indestructible creature.
2723-3734.description:
Deal damage to the indestructible creature.
Blazing Sunsteel and Phyrexian Metamorph trigger.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to any target.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to the indestructible creature.
Repeat from step 2.

4499-4659-5363.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Ezrim.
When Ezrim enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Clues, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead sacrifice the Clues to their own abilities.

1494-2289.notablePrerequisites:
Sovereign Okinec Ahau does not have summoning sickness.
Sage of Hours' power is at least five greater than its base power excluding any +1/+1 counters on it.
An opponent cannot block and kill Sovereign Okinec Ahau.
1494-2289.description:
Declare Sovereign Okinec Ahau as an attacker.
Sovereign Okinec Ahau triggers, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1633-2060-3415-4086-4120.description:
Cast Hanabi Blast by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Conspiracy Theorist's second ability triggers, allowing you to exile the discarded card from your graveyard if it was a nonland card and cast it from exile this turn.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Cast Hanabi Blast either from your hand or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

647-2232-4103-4747.description:
Activate Yidaro's cycling ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding it.
Yidaro triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Yidaro enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio.
Holding priority, activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least eight {R}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Alena from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Yidaro ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Cast Alena by paying {4}{R}.
Alena enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand.
 Repeat.

1877-3858.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
Your life total is greater than or equal to twenty minus the highest power among creatures you control.
1877-3858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, cast Hatred by paying {3}{B}{B} and an amount of life equal to nineteen minus the greatest power among creatures you control.
Resolve Hatred, causing the creature who has the greatest power among creatures you control to have a power of at least nineteen until end of turn.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life, and win the game.

776-1329-1886-2709.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Mechanics do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-1886-2709.description:
Tap Orcish Mechanics, sacrificing Jeweled Amulet to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Jeweled Amulet.
Cast Jeweled Amulet.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2440-3590-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Warchanter Skald.
You control at least four additional Dwarf and/or Berserker creatures.
2440-3590-5200.description:
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, tapping Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Dwarf and/or Berserker creature you control.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Warchanter Skald.
Repeat.

2034-4052-4963.notablePrerequisites:
"Bear" chosen with Kindred Discovery.
You have a way to draw a card or a bear in hand you can cast.
2034-4052-4963.description:
Activate Words of Wilding.
The next time you would draw a card, create a 2/2 bear token.
Kindred Discovery triggers.
Sacrifice the bear to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Before Kindred Discovery resolves, activate Words of Wilding, replacing your next draw with the creation of a 2/2 bear.
Repeat for infinite colorless mana, then repeat without sacrificing the bears for infinite bears.

2179-3263-4131.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {3}.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Basalt Monolith's last ability.
Resolve the copy of Basalt Monolith's last ability, untapping it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Basalt Monolith ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.
